10.1038/s44387-026-00102-5.title: Overview of the AgenticSciML evolutionary multi-agent framework.
10.1038/s44387-026-00102-5.caption: The diagram illustrates the three-phase structure of the framework. In Phase 1, the human user provides four structured inputs: a problem statement (Problem.md), implementation requirements (Requirements.md), evaluation criteria (Evaluation.md), and an optional dataset configuration (Data_config.json). In Phase 2, a Data Analyst agent performs exploratory data analysis on any provided training data and produces a text report for downstream agents; an Evaluator agent formalizes a testing contract (evaluate.py and guidelines.md) that is approved by the human user before proceeding. In Phase 3, the evolutionary loop runs iteratively: a Retriever agent selects relevant entries from the curated Knowledge Base (KB); Proposer and Critic agents engage in structured multi-round debate to produce an implementation proposal; an Engineer agent implements the proposal by modifying the parent solution’s code; a Debugger agent resolves runtime errors; and a Result Analyst agent evaluates the solution output and writes a report added to the Analysis Base. The process repeats until a stopping criterion is met, at which point the best-scoring solution on the tree is returned as the champion solution.

10.1038/s41524-026-02168-w.title: ∣ Overview of the Ara LLM-guided search workflow for COF photocatalyst discovery.
10.1038/s41524-026-02168-w.caption: a The combinatorial design space comprises 820 candidates formed from 7 trigonal nodes, 19 ditopic linkers, 4 linkage chemistries of varying hydrolytic stability, and 10 aromatic R-group substituents, subject to chemical compatibility constraints. b Each candidate is evaluated through a fragment-based screening pipeline: a node--linker--node repeat unit is assembled via RDKit, embedded in 3D, optimized with GFN1-xTB, and scored for band gap (IP − EA, mapped to the DFT scale via a calibrated transfer function), conduction-band minimum (CBM), and composite stability index (S CSI ). A candidate is classified as a hit if it satisfies all three criteria simultaneously. c Three search strategies are compared: random sampling, Bayesian optimization with a Gaussian process surrogate on Morgan fingerprints, and the Ara LLM agent, which iteratively proposes candidates with explicit chemical reasoning, receives quantitative feedback, and refines its selections over 200 iterations.
